## tal-a02-p01 (2.1-2.10)
[and]-:C2 atha śrītantrālokasya dvitīyamāhnikam yattatrādyaṃ padamaviratānuttarajñaptirūpaṃ / tannirṇetuṃ prakaraṇamidamārabhe@haṃ dvitīyam anupāyaṃ hi yadrūpaṃ ko@rtho deśanayātra vai / sakṛtsyāddeśanā paścādanupāyatvamucyayate anupāyamidaṃ tattvamityupāyaṃ vinā kutaḥ / svayaṃ tu teṣāṃ tattādṛk kiṃ brūmaḥ kila tānprati yaccaturdhoditaṃ rūpaṃ vijñānasya vibhorasau / svabhāva eva mantavyaḥ sa hi nityodito vibhuḥ etāvadbhirasaṃkhyātaiḥ svabhāvairyatprakāśate / ke@pyaṃśāṃśikayā tena viśantyanye niraṃśataḥ tatrāpi cābhyupāyādisāpekṣānyatvayogataḥ / upāyasyāpi no vāryā tadanyatvādvicitratā tatra ye nirmalātmāno bhairavīyāṃ svasaṃvidam / nirupāyāmupāsīnāstadvidhiḥ praṇigadyate tatra tāvatkriyāyogo nābhyupāyatvamarhati / sa hi tasmātsamudbhūtaḥ pratyuta pravibhāvyate jñaptāvupāya eva syāditi cejjñaptirucyate / prakāśatvaṃ svaprakāśe tacca tatrānyataḥ katham saṃvittattvaṃ svaprakāśamityasminkaṃ nu yuktibhiḥ / tadabhāve bhavedviśvaṃ jaḍatvādaprakāśakam

## tal-a02-p01–p05 — ahnika 2
**SUMMARY.** [and]-:C2 atha śrītantrālokasya dvitīyamāhnikam yattatrādyaṃ padamaviratānuttarajñaptirūpaṃ / tannirṇetuṃ prakaraṇamidamārabhe@haṃ dvitīyam anupāyaṃ hi yadrūpaṃ ko@rtho deśanayātra vai / sakṛtsyāddeśanā paścādanupāyatvamucyayate anupāyamidaṃ tattvamityupāyaṃ vinā kutaḥ / svayaṃ tu teṣāṃ tattādṛk kiṃ brūmaḥ kila tānprati yaccaturdhoditaṃ rūpaṃ vijñānasya vibhorasau / svabhāva eva mantavyaḥ sa hi nityodito vibhuḥ etāvadbhirasaṃkhyātaiḥ svabhāvairyatprakāśate / ke@pyaṃśāṃśikayā tena viśantyanye niraṃśataḥ tatrāpi cābhyupāyādisāpekṣānyatvayogataḥ / upāyasyāpi no vāryā tadanyatvādvicitratā tatra ye nirmalātmāno bhairavīyāṃ svasaṃvidam / nirupāyāmupāsīnāstadvidhiḥ praṇigadyate tatra tāvatkriyāyogo nābhyupāyatvamarhati / sa hi tasmātsamudbhūtaḥ pratyuta pravibhāvyate jñaptāvupāya eva syāditi cejjñaptirucyate / prakāśatvaṃ svaprakāśe tacca tatrānyataḥ katham saṃvittattvaṃ svaprakāśamityasminkaṃ nu yuktibhiḥ / tadabhāve bhavedviśvaṃ jaḍatvādaprakāśakam [and]-yāvānupāyo bāhyaḥ syādāntaro vāpi kaścana / sa sarvastanmukhaprekṣī tatropāyatvabhākkatham tyajāvadhānāni nanu kva nāma dhatse@vadhānaṃ vicinu svayaṃ tat / pūrṇe@vadhānaṃ na hi nāma yuktaṃ nāpūrṇamabhyeti ca satyabhāvam tenāvadhānaprāṇasya bhāvanādeḥ pare pathi / bhairavīye kathaṃkāraṃ bhavetsākṣādupāyatā ye@pi sākṣādupāyena tadrūpaṃ praviviñcate / nūnaṃ te sūryasaṃvittyai khadyotādhitsavo jaḍāḥ kiṃ ca yāvadidaṃ bāhyamāntaropāyasaṃmatam / tatprakāśātmatāmātraṃ śivasyaiva nijaṃ vapuḥ nīlaṃ pītaṃ sukhamiti prakāśaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥ / amuṣminparamādvaite prakāśātmani ko@paraḥ upāyopeyabhāvaḥ syātprakāśaḥ kevalaṃ hi saḥ idaṃ dvaitama@yaṃ bheda idamadvaitamityapi / prakāśavapurevāyaṃ bhāsate parameśvaraḥ asyāṃ bhūmau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bandho mokṣaścitarjaḍaḥ / ghaṭakumbhavadekārthāḥ śabdāste@pyekameva ca praśāśe hyaprakāśāṃśaḥ kathaṃ nāma prakāśatām / prakāśamāne tasminvā taddvaitāstasya lopitāḥ [and]-aprakāśe@tha tasminvā vastutā kathamucyate / na prakāśaviśeṣatvamata evopapadyate ata ekaprakāśo@yamiti vāde@tra susthite / dūrādāvāritāḥ satyaṃ vibhinnajñānavādinaḥ prakāśamātramuditamaprakāśaniṣedhanāt / ekaśabdasya na tvarthaḥ saṃkhyā cidvyaktibhedabhāk naiṣa śaktirmahādevī na paratrāśrito yataḥ / na caiṣa śaktimāndevo na kasyāpyāśrayo yataḥ naiṣa dhyeyo dhyātrabhāvānna dhyātā dhyeyavarjanāt / na pūjyaḥ pūjakābhāvātpūjyābhāvānna pūjakaḥ na mantro na ca mantryo@sau na ca mantrayitā prabhuḥ / na dīkṣā dīkṣako vāpi na dīkṣāvānmaheśvaraḥ sthānāsananirodhārghasaṃghānāvāhanādikam / visarjanāntaṃ nāstyatra kartṛkarmakriyojjhite na sanna cāsatsadasanna ca tannobhayojjhitam / durvijñeyā hi sāvasthā kimapyetadanuttaram ayamityavabhāso hi yo bhāvo@vacchidātmakaḥ / sa eva ghaṭavalloke saṃstathā naiṣa bhairavaḥ asattvaṃ cāprakāśatvaṃ na kutrāpyupayogitā / viśvasya jīvitaṃ satyaṃ prakāśaikātmakaśca saḥ [and]-ābhyāmeva tu hetubhyāṃ na dvyātmā na dvayojjhitaḥ / sarvātmanā hi bhātyeṣa kena rūpeṇa mantryatām śrīmattriśirasi proktaṃ parajñānasvarūpakam / śaktyā garbhāntarvartinyā śaktigarbha paraṃ padam na bhāvo nāpyabhāvo na dvayaṃ vācāmagocarāt / akathyapadavīrūḍhaṃ śaktisthaṃ śaktivarjitam iti ye rūḍhasaṃvittiparamārthapavitritāḥ / anuttarapathe rūḍhāste@bhyupāyāniyantritāḥ teṣāmidaṃ samābhāti sarvato bhāvamaṇḍalam / puraḥsthameva saṃvittibhairavāgnivilāpitam eteṣāṃ sukhaduḥkhāṃśaśaṃkātaṃkavikalpanāḥ / nirvikalpaparāveśamātraśeṣatvamāgatāḥ eṣāṃ na mantro na dhyānaṃ na pūjā nāpi kalpanā / na samayyādikācāryaparyantaḥ ko@pi viśramaḥ samastayantraṇātantratroṭanāṭaṃkadharmiṇaḥ / nānugrahātparaṃ kiṃciccheṣavṛttau prayojanam svaṃ kartavyaṃ kimapi kalayaṃlloka eṣa prayatnānno pārārthyaṃ prati ghaṭayate kāṃcana svapravṛttim / yastu dhvastākhilabhavamalo bhairavībhāvapūrṇaḥ kṛtyaṃ tasya sphuṭamidamiyallokakartavyamātram taṃ ye paśyanti tādrūpyakrameṇāmalasaṃvidaḥ / te@pi tadrūpiṇastāvatyevāsyānugrahātmatā [and]-etattattvaparijñānaṃ mukhyaṃ yāgādi kathyate / dīkṣāntaṃ vibhunā śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate sthaṇḍilāduttaraṃ tūraṃ tūrāduttarataḥ paṭaḥ / paṭāddhyānaṃ tato dhyeyaṃ tataḥ syāddhāraṇottarā tato@pi yogajaṃ rūpaṃ tato@pi jñānamuttaram / jñānena hi mahāsiddho bhavedyogīśvarastviti so@pi svātantryadhāmnā cedapyanirmalasaṃvidām / anugrahaṃ cikīrṣustadbhāvinaṃ vidhimāśrayet anugrāhyānusāreṇa vicitraḥ sa ca kathyate / parāparādyupāyaughasaṃkīrṇatvavibhedataḥ tadarthameva cāsyāpi parameśvararūpiṇaḥ / tadabhyupāyaśāstrādiśravaṇādhyayanādaraḥ nahi tasya svatantrasya kāpi kutrāpi khaṇḍanā / nānirmalacitaḥ puṃso@nugrahastvanupāyakaḥ śrīmadūrmimahāśāstre siddhasaṃtānarūpake / idamuktaṃ tathā śrīmatsomānandādidaiśikaiḥ gurorvākyādyuktipracayaracanonmārjanavaśāt samāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samuditādvāpi kathitāt / vilīne śaṃkābhre tdṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśata caraṇāndhvāntajayinaḥ idamanuttaradhāmavivecakaṃ vigalitaupayikaṃ kṛtamāhnikam

source.text: [and]-aprakāśe@tha tasminvā vastutā kathamucyate / na prakāśaviśeṣatvamata evopapadyate ata ekaprakāśo@yamiti vāde@tra susthite / dūrādāvāritāḥ satyaṃ vibhinnajñānavādinaḥ prakāśamātramuditamaprakāśaniṣedhanāt / ekaśabdasya na tvarthaḥ saṃkhyā cidvyaktibhedabhāk naiṣa śaktirmahādevī na paratrāśrito yataḥ / na caiṣa śaktimāndevo na kasyāpyāśrayo yataḥ naiṣa dhyeyo dhyātrabhāvānna dhyātā dhyeyavarjanāt / na pūjyaḥ pūjakābhāvātpūjyābhāvānna pūjakaḥ na mantro na ca mantryo@sau na ca mantrayitā prabhuḥ / na dīkṣā dīkṣako vāpi na dīkṣāvānmaheśvaraḥ sthānāsananirodhārghasaṃghānāvāhanādikam / visarjanāntaṃ nāstyatra kartṛkarmakriyojjhite na sanna cāsatsadasanna ca tannobhayojjhitam / durvijñeyā hi sāvasthā kimapyetadanuttaram ayamityavabhāso hi yo bhāvo@vacchidātmakaḥ / sa eva ghaṭavalloke saṃstathā naiṣa bhairavaḥ asattvaṃ cāprakāśatvaṃ na kutrāpyupayogitā / viśvasya jīvitaṃ satyaṃ prakāśaikātmakaśca saḥ

source.text: [and]-ābhyāmeva tu hetubhyāṃ na dvyātmā na dvayojjhitaḥ / sarvātmanā hi bhātyeṣa kena rūpeṇa mantryatām śrīmattriśirasi proktaṃ parajñānasvarūpakam / śaktyā garbhāntarvartinyā śaktigarbha paraṃ padam na bhāvo nāpyabhāvo na dvayaṃ vācāmagocarāt / akathyapadavīrūḍhaṃ śaktisthaṃ śaktivarjitam iti ye rūḍhasaṃvittiparamārthapavitritāḥ / anuttarapathe rūḍhāste@bhyupāyāniyantritāḥ teṣāmidaṃ samābhāti sarvato bhāvamaṇḍalam / puraḥsthameva saṃvittibhairavāgnivilāpitam eteṣāṃ sukhaduḥkhāṃśaśaṃkātaṃkavikalpanāḥ / nirvikalpaparāveśamātraśeṣatvamāgatāḥ eṣāṃ na mantro na dhyānaṃ na pūjā nāpi kalpanā / na samayyādikācāryaparyantaḥ ko@pi viśramaḥ samastayantraṇātantratroṭanāṭaṃkadharmiṇaḥ / nānugrahātparaṃ kiṃciccheṣavṛttau prayojanam svaṃ kartavyaṃ kimapi kalayaṃlloka eṣa prayatnānno pārārthyaṃ prati ghaṭayate kāṃcana svapravṛttim / yastu dhvastākhilabhavamalo bhairavībhāvapūrṇaḥ kṛtyaṃ tasya sphuṭamidamiyallokakartavyamātram taṃ ye paśyanti tādrūpyakrameṇāmalasaṃvidaḥ / te@pi tadrūpiṇastāvatyevāsyānugrahātmatā

source.text: [and]-etattattvaparijñānaṃ mukhyaṃ yāgādi kathyate / dīkṣāntaṃ vibhunā śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate sthaṇḍilāduttaraṃ tūraṃ tūrāduttarataḥ paṭaḥ / paṭāddhyānaṃ tato dhyeyaṃ tataḥ syāddhāraṇottarā tato@pi yogajaṃ rūpaṃ tato@pi jñānamuttaram / jñānena hi mahāsiddho bhavedyogīśvarastviti so@pi svātantryadhāmnā cedapyanirmalasaṃvidām / anugrahaṃ cikīrṣustadbhāvinaṃ vidhimāśrayet anugrāhyānusāreṇa vicitraḥ sa ca kathyate / parāparādyupāyaughasaṃkīrṇatvavibhedataḥ tadarthameva cāsyāpi parameśvararūpiṇaḥ / tadabhyupāyaśāstrādiśravaṇādhyayanādaraḥ nahi tasya svatantrasya kāpi kutrāpi khaṇḍanā / nānirmalacitaḥ puṃso@nugrahastvanupāyakaḥ śrīmadūrmimahāśāstre siddhasaṃtānarūpake / idamuktaṃ tathā śrīmatsomānandādidaiśikaiḥ gurorvākyādyuktipracayaracanonmārjanavaśāt samāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samuditādvāpi kathitāt / vilīne śaṃkābhre tdṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśata caraṇāndhvāntajayinaḥ idamanuttaradhāmavivecakaṃ vigalitaupayikaṃ kṛtamāhnikam
